Game Overview

Escape the Police puts players into a police experience centered on dodge relentless police forces and strategize your way through the city as the most wanted fugitive. Outsmart your pursuers and plan daring escapes in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, where quick thinking and sharp reflexes are your ultimate survival tools.

How to Play

Each session of Escape the Police follows a consistent rhythm. Dodge relentless police forces and strategize your way through the city as the most wanted fugitive. Outsmart your pursuers and plan daring escapes in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, where quick thinking and sharp reflexes are your ultimate survival tools.
